reviews.review_description: Quote came quickly, job complete quickly and neatly, good customer service would recommend

From the first phone call I felt comfortable with the advice and knowledge from Troy an his team, you knew you weren't just talking to a salesperson. Everything was done when they said it would be, the only delays being due to the high demand on our provider for approval.The intallers were punctual, polite and proffesional.The rebate savings on offer from the government are amazing and your mad if you don't do something now, particularly with the green energy loans that are available through Reef solar.All in all an easy process.AB

Very easy to talk to and get a quote .Installation was very neat and tidy and system works perfectly.Reef solar and electrical did a amazing job with grid connection installation and was very easy to deal with , very happy with the process and product.

I am extremely happy that we went with Reef Solar and Electrical Gladstone to install our new solar system.  The workers were respectful to our family, efficient with their time and meticulous with their placement of the panels. They also talked through the options for the inverter installation and took time to show us how it worked.The solar looks wonderful, works perfectly and we will never have to pay another power bill.I couldn’t recommend them enough.

Got a 10KW system with 30kWh of batteries in one full stack. Troy was always happy to answers any questions and answers calls or calls back promptly. I was inclined to go with Deye as they did 30kWh of batteries in one stack. I found once hitting two stacks the price ramped up quite a bit.The whole process was went smoothly. Due to new rebates there was about a 4 week wait which was fine. The team did the install across two days as it was replacing an old system. Very happy with the install and quality so far.
Sales process was simple and straightforward, installation was done at a time convenient to me and was completed within the specified timeframe

Installation was promised 1 month after acceptance of quote.  Installation happened as planned - installers were in at 0730 am and job finished just after lunch.  Employees all dressed in company work attire and, importantly, wore hats in the sun.Reef attended to all things necessary to ensure the system worked as expected.  They set up phone and computer apps to check operation of system.All things considered, our association with Troy and his gang could not be faulted.

New Build ExperienceTroy had a terrific knowledge of solar and helped us select the right system for us now and looking into our future.When the house was ready he was reachable and had it installed and up running within the week.Thanks
Very easy to deal with when even dealing with delays. Always available through out the time frame between quotation and delivery.

We are so impressed with how well our solar is working for us. From the initial enquiry to the final installation and the after sales service are more than we could ever hoped for. Troy and his team were so easy to deal with and would recommend them to anyone who is considering solar
Troy and the team at Reef Solar made the whole process hassle free from start to finish. Would recommend.
Great communication, speedy service and friendly staff. Will definitely recommend to friends and family. Thanks Troy and team.
Would recommend you deal with Troy nothing was too much, always polite and very professional.

Sales quotes were transparent with a full breakdown of cost, as well as energy cost savings and greenhouse gas emission reduction charts which were easy to understand.Troy explained the process in full and provide a competitive quote within a day of asking.We installed a larger commercial solar system just under 100kW, and Troy navigated the regulatory and compliance for us, subsequently limiting the paperwork requirements that we would normally be burdened with.Reef Solar have now secured a further 120Kw solar install contract for the Gladstone Airport.

Troy from Reef Solar & Electrical has been great to work with during the entire process.From the beginning, the process was thorough and professional. He asked for my power bills and did the math based on average sun hours throughout the year and the updated lower tariffs to show exactly how much I could expect to save (which was and has been at least half my power bill). He provided a detailed PDF with the figures, a mock-up of the system design and look, and walked me through the brand, inverter details, the phone app, Ergon website and even future options like adding batteries and hybrid inverter.Communication was excellent throughout. Troy stayed in constant contact and kept me updated everything. Originally, he mentioned being booked out for 6-8 weeks, but I got a pleasant surprise call saying they could install the following week.The installation itself was speedy completed in just a couple of days, and the team was polite, tidy, and efficient. The pricing was also very competitive, making the whole package great value for money. Overall, I couldn’t be happier with the experience and would highly recommend them. The system works great and I've had no faults or issues since the installation.  I have received a power bill since the installation and the information originally provided has been pretty much spot on with the bill in terms of cost/savings on my power.

Thank you so much guys for everything, you were very understanding and patient with me and extremely helpful with great customer service, support and a quick response with fast installation that tops it all off, we wouldn't go anywhere else and would recommend anyone who wants or need solar to go to Reef Solar and Electrical
Troy and his team from quote to install and after sales info are faultless . For a solar install I would highly recommend his services. Thanks again guys…..
Quick tidy and great pricing. Highly recommend Troy and his team.
Great communication, very flexible, product seems quality, super nice team, no long waiting periods, decent value, quick install, would definitely recommend.

Spoke with Troy regarding my requirements for 6.6kW Solar System. Went through options I had for panels and Inverters  and Design which was easy to understand and was quick to reply to questions I had. Installation crew were punctual having travelled two hours from Gladstone and performed the installation like a professional outfit should.Electrician explained how inverter worked and set up Isolar app for me. Overall very pleased with the installation outcome.
The team from reef Solar were great to deal with. Very knowledgeable, polite, and their quality of work is great.

From the quoting process to the install of the system, Reef Solar were a pleasure to work with, very friendly, informative and patient with any queries or concerns I raised and the work carried out on the install of my 10 KW system was to a high standard. I'm very happy with the experience and will be recommending them to anyone looking to install a solar system.
Troy and Kai were most obliging through our entire install and we would recommend them to any people considering solar.

We recently had a solar system installed by Troy and the team at Reef Solar & Electrical, and the overall experience was smooth and professional. Communication was a standout — the team kept us well-informed throughout the process and were quick to answer any questions. Brandon was happy to assist with any installation questions when on site.

Troy came out specifically to have a look at our set up because it was a bit of a different job - he gave us his thoughts, provided a quote quickly, made arrangements for our booking to be in so we could get started as soon as the electricity was hooked up and his team completed the job in a couple of business days due to weather. Very happy with the system, price and service - and we got a free Fire Barbie thanks to falling into the allotted time for his giveaway.

From the moment contact was made Troy & the entire team from Reef Solar & Electrical made the entire process of our solar system installation  a very comfortable and fuss free experience. Would highly recommend their company to anyone considering a solar installation. They are very professional and easy to work deal with. We are very happy with the standard of work & the transparent process we received from Troy and his team.Regards Mark & Deb

We recently had our solar system upgraded by Reef Solar, and the entire experience was excellent from start to finish. The staff were incredibly friendly, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly, which made the whole process smooth and stress-free.Their pricing was very competitive, and we felt we were getting great value for money with the quality of service and equipment provided. The installation was handled efficiently, and we’re really happy with how everything turned out.Highly recommend Reef Solar to anyone looking to upgrade or install a solar system — you’ll be in good hands!
Very helpful from our 1st enquiry through to completion. Installation was very efficient and tidy with the hand over and follow up excellent.
All was very fast, done a great job on the install

Troy is highly knowledgeable and provided several options for consideration.   We were kept well informed of the installation process and we couldn't be more pleased with the level of professionalism and integrity in which this company works by.    We did our own research and found that everything Troy suggested were solar manufactuers with a long history of the highest quality products.   If you are looking for an honest and reliable company, look no further than Reef Solar and Electric.
Great job by installers, workmanship excellent and good value for money
Very friendly people to deal with, they did what they said they would at the agreed price, very professional and courteous tradies, very happy with the install - thank you Reef Solar
Troy was great to deal with, quick, all information provided that I wanted and instal was great

Customer service was excellent through the whole process.From request for quote, to explanation of choice of equipment, Reef Solar didn’t disappoint.Installation went ahead very quickly and without drama.Final explanation and demonstration of inverter and the app was most helpful.Highly recommend Reef Solar.
Prompt quote, Ergon all organised, I didn’t have to do anything. Installation was punctual and workers were polite and cleaned up after themselves.
The installation crew was great, arrived on time & got straight into the installation.Great system knowledge, they answered all of my questions.Can't recommend them enough!

Reef Solar & Electrical provided great customer service, our commercial retail shop had a good size roof and we wanted a 20kW system with a three phase inverter to maximise and use the full 15kW QLD solar feed-in tariff yield.Troy the owner spent a great of time and care to ensure we achieved the best solar panel configuration for our retail shop roof, we wanted the panels to look symmetrical neat and professional which is what we got.The 3-Phase 20kW inverter was mounted inside and very neatly tied into out existing distribution board.I’m an electrical engineer and know what good work looks, for me to be happy the workmanship needs to be top notch.I would have no hesitation in recommending Reef Solar & Electrical to anyone wanting either a home or commercial solar system installation.

Great team to deal with right from the moment asking for a quote. Fast service and installation. Very smooth process from start to finish even with a bit of a different issue that we threw in the mix.

Very happy with my experience with Reef Solar & Electrical, from the initial call to the proposed solar  layout and up to installation, excellent customer service, professional team completed the install and were more than willing to answer any questions I had.
Troy was so professional and efficient and the team’s workmanship was excellent. We are thrilled with the whole system and with Reef solar. Thank you very much!

We spoke with a number of companies before calling Reef Solar and ElectricalAfter calling Troy, it was easy to decide who to go with. Troy was incredibly easy to talk with, and offered better service and options, with no pressure or sales pitch.Installation was smooth, the crew arrived on time, communicated throughout the day, and confirmed all details were working before leavingWe’d 100% recommend

The Reef Solar team was great to work with and the new system was installed with no dramas and looks to be working beautifully!  Although the system has only been in for two weeks and we have had some very cloudy days here in CQ, my monthly power bill has been reduced by over $100 for the two weeks since installation (system was up and running on Thurs 20th March, and my first bill came today on 3rd April).

Spoke with Troy with regards to solar after I enquired through SolarQuotes. I told him what we required and what we were going to do further down the track, re batteries, he sent me quotes with and without batteries. We discussed the options after the quotes came through then scheduled to have the system installed end of March. Due to the rain the installation took two days. The teams that arrived on both days were very friendly, professional and cleaned up after themselves also. We are very happy with the system installation. Will now wait to see what our next power bill be in 3 months time.Cheers Sharon

Troy and his team at Reef Solar and Electrical has been nothing short of fantastic.From the initial quote and the time Troy took to speak with myself and husband to the install day was all seamless, prompt and professional.Any issues that arose were handled with care and great communication.Troy was able to squeeze us in sooner then expected also which was a great suprise. We upgraded the system last minute to a larger set up and it's been performing so well!!We wouldn't hesitate to recommend Troy and the team and Reef Solar and Electrical to friends and family!Thanks again!

We contacted Reef Solar after observing them install solar across the road from us. From the get go I found Troy and the team very approachable and informative about all aspects of solar. The quoting process was simple and the team arrived on time and tidied up well after themselves. The process did take a day longer than originally expected due to wiring being a little more difficult to install through the top storey of our two storey house. I did have to contact them to find out when they were due back the next week but once they set a day and time they stuck to it and had the job completed. Troy also followed up the next week to see that every thing was going to plan and ensure we didn’t have any questions. All in all the process from start to finish was quite simple and I’d recommend Reef Solar to anyone looking for great service from a local team.

Fantastic service from quote to installation, everything was taken care of with the minimum of fuss. Instillation was done to a high standard and follow up from the owner was a really nice touch. I would absolutely recommend Reef solar and electrical!
Like little elves, all had jobs which they did, no time wasted, happy workers

Just had Troy and the team replace my existingsystem to a larger one with battery backup.From my first query to job completion was faultless. Troy and his team did an excellent job. The installation team were a pleasure to deal with punctual, polite and very tidy. I would highly recommend Reef Solar and Electrical to anyone.

I was replacing my current system and requested a quote, Reef Solar phoned me within 30 minutes.  While on the phone, Reef Solar emailed me a diagram of what my roof would look like with the solar panels installed.Before accepting the quote, I had quite a few questions about the panels, cost and install.  Troy answered my questions and was patient.I was kept in the loop of when the install would happen. The installer phoned me with approximate time they would be at the premises.  Cyclone Alfred was  hovering off the coast and this could have delayed the install.Reef Solar has fantastic customer service and I recommend them to anyone looking at new solar or replacing.  They also install outside of Gladstone.

From the start it has been a pleasant experience. Troy was very helpful and knowledgeable. We agreed on a date for installation and when we couldn't be home because of unforeseen circumstances, he simply said "no worries mate, we'll fit you in when you get back home." Amazing service and great work. Everything was explained in detail when the installers rocked up. Thank you very much.

From the first phone call, I was provided clear advice on the best way forward for our solar needs.Very professional and knowledgeable and the installation crew were a great group of guys.Everything installed and up and going in one day.Very impressed with the quality of service provided and glad we chose Reef Solar. Would definitely recommend.

Everything from the start to finish was easy to deal with. Troy was great to deal with, always able to answer calls and questions. The install went well, ripping the old system and putting the new one on  in a day.Highly recommend!!
Great process of quote, install and customer care from Reef Solar. Would use them again for sure!

Troy and his team were both friendly and professional throughout the entire process of installing our system. From giving a quote to completing the installation they were very helpful. They worked incredibly hot days but still completed the job in very good time.After the installation was completed we had a problem with the system (this was not the fault of the system or the installers.) We contacted Troy and he was able to pinpoint the problem quickly. The problem was that we had changed our Internet password so needed to update the password on our device. Troy sent us information to for this and offered to come out to our place if we were unable to fix it. He was very pleasant and knowledgeable.They are very good at what they do. I certainly recommend them to anyone.

The process of quoting through to installation was very easy and nothing was a problem. The guys answered any questions we had and helped set up the app to track usage etc.Installation was quick and the guys made sure everything was neat and tidy!
Easy, efficient and attentive. Organised all paperwork and did a good job installing
Troy was great to deal with right from the initial phone call for a quote.  Everything was done in a timely manner and was a simple process.Thanks

From initial conversation through to job completion my experience has been above expectations. Troy listened to my needs and designed the system around this conversation. The install team were accepting to some aesthetic requests I had and completed the job in a tidy and punctual fashion. Troy called me a few weeks after the install to check in. I have not looked back upon my decision to go Solar with his Company. We'll done team, I'm another Satisfied Customer.
Simple phone call and email for quoting and all information, system all fitted in a day
Fast quote and easy to talk to. Quick turnaround from quote to installation and very professional
Reef Solar and Electrical answered all our questions and visited the site before providing their quote. The installation team worked well together and explained how everything installed operated.

After lodging my request for quotes Troy from Reef Solar was quick to contact me and start putting together a quote. His knowledge and guidance was excellent and was happy to discuss options in both equipment and installation position of the system.On the day of the installation the crew were punctual and very easy to work with. We were able to discuss location of cabling for aesthetics. Once on site they were also able to tweak the design to better suit our houseHighly recommend.

The team at Reef Solar & Electrical did a great job during the installation.They also installed a new power box in a neat and tidy fashion.Troy was fantastic at answering questions & provided great service.
Excellent service, great price on our solar system very easy to deal with no hidden cost tradesman where helpful polite and neat and tidy will recommend
The guys at Reef solar were great to deal with.

From the first phone call to dropping into Reef Solar & Electricals office, everything to do with my solar installation was easy, prompt and provided peace of mind that I was getting a quality system and a high standard of workmanship, as well as confidence in ongoing local support if needed.

Very prompt response for request for quote.Quote very competitive.Provided competent advice on costs.Regular updates on project installation.Professional Customer Service.Quality Trade Job.Provided Owners Manual and Warranty  Top Job.WELL DONE.  Very Pleased.  Very Proud
Troy has been so helpful and patient with us during our recent decision to install our solar system.  Highly recommend Reef Solar and Electrical in Gladstone.

I recently had a solar system installed by Reef Solar & Electrical and am very pleased with the entire experience. The sales and quoting process was straightforward, with the team providing clear information and answering my questions promptly, which helped me make an informed decision.The installation itself was completed smoothly. The installers were punctual, polite, and maintained a tidy workspace throughout. They took care to clean up after themselves and ensured that everything was installed safely and professionally.After the installation, the customer service team was equally supportive. They assisted in organizing the grid connection and provided guidance on how to monitor the system’s performance. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the installation quality and the professionalism of the entire team. Highly recommended for anyone considering solar.

Customer service is exceptional.The team were quick and neat. They were respectful to the neighbours and the after sales contact to check in on us has been refreshing.I would thoroughly recommend these guys to anyone and everyone.

I found the whole experience easy to understand.  The advice on the size of the system I required, the quote, my many questions were all given very professionally.They arrived at the time given.The installation went smoothly. My old system was removed, and everything was left very clean and tidy.The installers were excellent, and kept me posted with each stage.They organised the App for me on my phone, and explained how the Inverter worked.

Wonderful experience! Troy was reliable and informative from the beginning of the process to the end. His staff are courteous, efficient and best of all - they clean up after themselves!! Spotless yard left after their work.Very informative - help with apps etc. Troy even rang me a few days later after reviewing my solar and checked in.Would totally recommend!!!!

Awesome customer service and information provided on quote on system, very professional and experience provided on installation.Everything was sorted out by provider and made process easy. Very happy with the service.

Experience with Troy and team, from quotation stage to final installation went smoothly. Mitch and the installation team was very friendly and professional. Installation was done on time, very neat and the team cleaned up after installation.Very happy with Reef Solar and I can highly recommend their service.We are now sitting back and hoping to enjoy many years of solar power convenience.
Troy and the gang at Reef Solar were great to deal with. We didn’t have to worry about a thing.We would highly recommend them.
Good communication, quality install and professional service, in and out like they were never here.

Fast response to my initial enquiry. Detailed discussion by phone about the options for my home. Installation was booked in much sooner than expected. On the day the installers consulted about location of the inverter. Installation was completed efficiently and tidily. Checked the app immediately and the system was creating power. Installed end of August so I've received my first monthly electricity bill and can confirm the system is working well.

I already ready had an existing solar system that was performing well but wasn’t enough with the renos we have done.  Troy considered my budget and bang for buck he suggested another system the same as mine. Happy with the honesty and overall a Good job on the installation
Very polite and prompt service. Explained how it will help me with heating my pool
They're very professional and easy to deal with throughout the whole process.

Great Service start to completion. Explained everything in detail. Installers workmanship fantastic and on time each day.Every tidy and cleaned up everything when finished.Would certainly recommend and have already.Julie and Peter Marshall
The process from start to finish with Reef Solar was outstanding. No hassles.The communication was excellent, and product info was great also.Would recommend.

When we first had contact for the quote, we found Troy very friendly and professional. Troy explained all aspects of the solar system and ably answered all our questions.The guys that came to install the panels were great. They were so polite and friendly and explained everything they were doing.Once the installation was complete, we had minor things to attend to that was completed with the same friendly guys. Reef Solar arranged the grid connection and anything else that was needed doing.Reef Solar supplied us with a very detailed owners manual.Would highly recommend Reef Solar and Electrical to anyone.
Quoting was to the point - factual, accurate and no B/S. Installation was professional, with quality workmanship and completed as planned. The whole process start to finish has been spot on.
Great customer service and quick installation.They were easy to talk to and to understand.

We were extremely happy with the entire process of getting quotes from several contractors who responded promptly and provided helpful information.Our chosen contractor arranged all necessary information and documents for connection with the supply authority for our area.The installation procedure was straight forward and completed to our expectations.
